title: Arvind B NDE 6372
content: I had heart trouble on Feb. 29, 2012. I went to my general practitioner feeling it could be one of those 'gas' issues. The ECG suggested that I should be hospitalized immediately. I had already started experiencing terrible pain in my left hand. I reached the hospital and was immediately taken to OT. I had a successful angioplasty with one stent inserted. I came out on stretcher with thumbs up to all those relatives and friends who had reached hospital by then. I blabbered to them that I'd be back home in two days and that nobody should really be bothered. The trouble seemed to be over. Then I blinked at my wonderful, lovely wife and kind of reassured her with my eyes. Most of them left the hospital and went to the tea canteen downstairs to have that Indian quintessential cup of tea! The trouble started soon after. I blacked out and started vomiting blood. I needed a total of 11 bottles of blood in the next 24 hours. I came to know later that it was Cardio Respiratory Arrest. The last thing I remember that is someone was sitting on my chest and thumping it heavily and that I was being taken away somewhere on the stretcher. The next thing I remember is myself on something like a bench in the operating room and I was given electric shocks. I started drifting upward. From a height, I could see my own body with many doctors and medical personnel working on my body. I could see the instrument panel flat. I don't really know if it was pulse or something else, but something that surely should not be flat. I reached the top of the hall and kind of stuck to a corner of that hall. I was happy. Yes, that is true. I remember myself smiling all the time. First, I saw four children in my path, all of them in the 10 to 12 years age group. All wore happy faces. I could see only the faces and not their bodies. At some distance, I could see some people standing in a circle, this time I could see all of them. It was around 8 to 10 people. Then I saw a huge light in the center of the hall and I started drifting towards it. There was a huge light coming in from that huge hole. I am a fervent Hindu with blind faith in the Super Power. To be more specific, I firmly believe in our Goddess, Mother Kaalika. I could feel that she was there on the other side of that beam of bright light coming from outside the hall. I was happy to know that she was there outside. I bowed and tried to see her. That was the last thing I remember from the out-of-world experience. The next thing I remember is my doctor asking me how I was feeling. Later I came to know that I was on ventilator for 5 days, and that news of 'my death' had already spread among many of my relatives and friends. This happened at the Hospital in Indore, India. Above all, it was my wife's unwavering faith that nothing would happen to me that brought me back to life. There were people who had started weeping, but Rinku, my wife, did not. She started praying to our Goddess and requesting her to meet me. I met her indeed. And then, I was back.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Goddess Mother Kaalika (Kaalika) was felt to be on the other side of the bright light/beam.
arrival.other_being_detail: Saw four children (faces only) and later 8-10 people standing in a circle.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described being in a hall/operating room-like space with a huge light coming through a 'huge hole'.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: After bowing/trying to see the Goddess beyond the bright light, the next memory was the doctor asking how he was feeling.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Fervent Hindu; devotion to Goddess Mother Kaalika.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Observed unidentified children (faces only) and a group of 8-10 people in a circle; felt Goddess presence beyond the light.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in operating room/hall with observation of body and people, then drifted toward a huge bright light; no tunnel described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The 'other realm' was described as a hall/operating-room-like space with a huge hole/beam of light; saw only faces of four children (no bodies).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I started drifting upward. From a height, I could see my own body with many doctors and medical personnel working on my body.”
